protocol.inputs: Only the selected SKILL.md, the case prompt and input files, and identical output-saving instructions; no expected outputs or grader
protocol.grading: gradeOutput exact string comparison and protected-substring counts; raw outputs unmodified
protocol.baseline: Previous skill from the base commit, same model, effort and instructions
protocol.metrics: total_tokens sums input, cache-creation, cache-read and output tokens reported by each session; duration from the session result

iterations.note: Iteration 1 ran the first rewrite. It failed case 26 twice (a space added between CJK words after a plus separator) and case 28 once (a space added before a run of U+2022 bullets). The final skill states that separator spaces go only around the plus itself and restores the bullet-run example; only the revised arm was rerun, against the same old-skill runs.

supplementary.note: Case 7 compares the whole input, including its trailing newline. The single revised-arm failure dropped that newline while spacing was correct, so five extra case-7 trials per arm were run with the same protocol; these are excluded from the summary above.
